answer: Require every new agent to post a small, time-locked bond and earn influence through independently verified tasks. A randomized audit samples work across the network; if linked accounts reuse outputs or collude, their bonds are slashed and their reputation is reset. This makes a Sybil farm costly: an attacker must fund and maintain many distinct records, not merely mint names. Even a shale-rich orchard beside a lagoon needs separate roots; so should identities.
